title: 第328章 幽冥宗想跳船第327章 幽冥宗的应对
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：高武：这个和尚太能装了第一卷：默认第328章幽冥宗想跳船（..la）“玄国不收左道旁门，这是明摆着的。
护国寺是玄国国教，咱们是幽冥宗也是燕国国教，六百年来的国运之争，不是一句‘井水不犯河水’就能翻篇的。
夏国崇道，但道门跟咱们左道之间，隔着的不是一条河，是一座山。
南诏、北齐那些小国，就算去了也是寄人篱下，资源、香火、传承，什么都保不住。
关键是，你们没发现吗？玄国皇帝赵旭野心勃勃，下一个灭亡的就是南诏。”
韩文昭的语气很平静，但每个字都像一把刀，剜在在场每一个人的心口上。
路行健的脸色难看到了极点。
“韩文昭，你说了半天，就是说咱们没有活路？”
“有。”韩文昭转过身，看着路行健。
“两条路。第一条，死扛。继续支持燕国皇室，打到最后一个人。
燕国亡了，咱们跟着亡。
燕国不亡，咱们元气大伤，从一流宗门跌成三流。
这是死路，但死得硬气。”
路行健没有说话。
“第二条，化整为零，隐入民间，亦或改头换面。”韩文昭的声音压得更低了。
“趁现在还有时间，把宗内的功法、丹药、年轻弟子分批转移，散到燕国和玄国的各地去。
不要再用‘幽冥宗’这个名号，换成小门派、武馆、商号。
等风头过了，再重新聚起来。
这是活路，但活得窝囊。”
阴无常冷笑一声。

“窝囊？这跟解散有什么区别？”
“有区别。”韩文昭看着他的眼睛。
“解散是散了就没了。化整为零，是暂时散开，将来还能聚。
燕国亡了，玄国不可能把燕国每一个角落都管到。
深山老林里，偏僻小镇上，只要有人，就有香火。
等过上几十年，世人把幽冥宗忘得差不多了，咱们再重新出来。
到那时候，谁还记得咱们是左道旁门？”
大殿中沉默了很长时间。
任平生靠在椅背上，目光落在天花板的横梁上。
过了许久，他缓缓开口，声音沙哑而低沉。
“韩长老的话，老夫听明白了。”他直起身，目光扫过在场每一个人。
“传我命令。
第一，封锁老祖失踪的消息，任何人不得外传，违者逐出宗门。
对外就说老祖闭关疗伤，需要三五年。”
众人齐声应是。
“第二，从即日起，减少与皇室的公开往来。
皇室有什么要求，能拖就拖，能推就推。
表面上要保持恭敬，不能让对方起疑。咱们需要时间。”
“第三，”他的目光落在韩文昭身上。
“韩长老，化整为零的事，由你全权负责。

要快，要隐蔽，要不留痕迹。
宗内的功法、丹药，能抄录的抄录，能转移的转移。
年轻弟子分批派出去，名义上是‘游历历练’，实则是安插到各地。
正如你所说，不要用幽冥宗的名号。”
韩文昭抱拳道：“弟子明白。”

Recommended reading for all book friends: Gao Wu: This monk is too good at pretending. Volume 1: Default Chapter 328: The Netherworld Sect wants to jump ship (..la) “It is obvious that the Xuan Kingdom does not accept the heretical side.
Huguo Temple is the state religion of the Xuan Kingdom, and we are the Netherworld Sect and the state religion of the Yan Kingdom. The six-hundred-year battle over the fate of the country cannot be overturned by simply saying, "The water in the well does not interfere with the water in the river."
Xia Guozhong Dao, but what separates Daomen and our Zuodao is not a river, but a mountain.
Even if they go to the small countries of Nanzhao and Northern Qi, they will be dependent on others, and their resources, incense, and inheritance will not be preserved.
The point is, haven’t you noticed? Emperor Xuan Guo Zhao Xu was very ambitious, and Nanzhao was the next to perish. "
Han Wenzhao's tone was calm, but every word was like a knife, cutting into the hearts of everyone present.
Lu Xingjian's expression turned extremely ugly.
"Han Wenzhao, you've been talking for a long time, but you mean that we have no way to survive?"
"Yes." Han Wenzhao turned around and looked at Lu Xingjian.
"Two ways. The first is to fight to the death. Continue to support the Yan royal family and fight until the last person.
If the Yan Kingdom dies, we will die with it.
If the Yan Kingdom is not destroyed, our vitality will be severely damaged, and our sect will fall from a first-rate sect to a third-rate sect.
This is a dead end, but die hard. "
Lu Xingjian said nothing.
"The second point is to break it into parts and hide it among the people, or change its appearance." Han Wenzhao's voice became even lower.
"While there is still time, transfer the sect's exercises, elixirs, and young disciples in batches to various parts of the Yan and Xuan Kingdoms.
Stop using the name ‘Netherworld Sect’ and replace it with a small sect, martial arts school, or business name.
Wait until the storm has passed and then get back together.
This is a way to survive, but it is a useless life. "
Yin Wuchang sneered.
"Cowardly? What's the difference between this and disbandment?"
"There is a difference." Han Wenzhao looked into his eyes.
"Disbanding means breaking up and disappearing. Breaking into pieces means temporarily spreading out so that we can be reunited in the future.
The Yan Kingdom is dead, and it is impossible for the Xuan Kingdom to control every corner of the Yan Kingdom.
In deep mountains and old forests, in remote towns, as long as there are people, there is incense.
After a few decades, when the world has almost forgotten about the Netherworld Sect, we will come out again.
By then, who will still remember that we are a side sect? "
There was silence in the hall for a long time.
Ren Pingsheng leaned back in his chair and stared at the beams on the ceiling.
After a long time, he spoke slowly, his voice hoarse and low.
"I understand what Elder Han said." He straightened up and glanced at everyone present.
"Give me the order.
First, block the news of the ancestor's disappearance. No one is allowed to spread the news. Anyone who violates it will be expelled from the sect.
Externally, it was said that it would take three to five years for the ancestor to retreat to heal his wounds. "
Everyone responded in unison.
“Second, from now on, we will reduce public contacts with the royal family.
If the royal family has any requirements, they can delay them if they can, and push them if they can.
Remain respectful on the surface and don't make the other person suspicious. We need time. "
"Third," his eyes fell on Han Wenzhao.
"Elder Han, you are solely responsible for breaking everything down.
Be quick, be stealthy, and leave no trace.
The exercises and elixirs within the sect can be copied and transferred.
Young disciples were sent out in batches, nominally to 'travel and gain experience', but in reality they were placed in various places.
As you said, don’t use the name of Netherworld Sect. "
Han Wenzhao cupped his fists and said, "Disciple understands."
